Marketing would like to feature Clearsight in a short customer excerpt (1–2 paragraphs) and include the Clearsight logo and a 1-line quote from your Head of Data.

- Can we get permission to use the Clearsight logo (full-color and monochrome) on our website and one-page collateral?

We can link to your site and include the quote verbatim if that works. If you prefer, we can route a short permission/consent doc for signature.

Hi Kimberly — thanks for sending this over and for the thoughtful copy. Clearsight is happy to be highlighted. A few small points from our side:

- The proposed quote attributed to Priya Desai (Head of Data) looks good; she asked to change one phrase (see inline in the doc).
- We can grant logo usage for the website and marketing collateral; please use the \"product partner\" lockup and keep clearspace as specified.
- Attaching our latest brand guidelines (clearsight_brand_guidelines_v2.pdf) — they include acceptable colorways, minimum sizes, and co-branding lockup rules.
- We request a soft embargo until May 1 for public social posts; website/partner page updates are fine on May 3 as planned.

I'll loop in legal (cc) to sign the formal permission. If you can provide a final PDF of the excerpt and a one-page permission doc, we can sign and return by Thursday.

Attachment: clearsight_brand_guidelines_v2.pdf

Cheers,
